changes.title: Ground support decisions in authoritative lookups

title: Ground airline support in authoritative state
summary:
Updated the active airline-support policy to prioritize authoritative lookups over customer summaries, reducing reliance on potentially stale or incomplete information.

- Clarified action boundaries and required complete corrections covering current seats and authorization scope.
- Added regression tests for policy consumption and unchanged tool/model wiring. Tests and simulations were not run, so behavioral improvement remains unverified.
inconsistency: The change summary states that tests and simulations were not run, but the supplied environment outcomes report a score improvement. The source of that outcome is not explained.
